The lamp light was moved from the lamp/monitor midpoint to (376.31, -1233.11, 119.769), 51.18 cm from the monitor origin and on the lamp side farthest from the monitor; source_radius is 4.0 and soft_source_radius is 10.0. The monitor mesh Infinigen_MonitorFactory_1148210__spawn_asset_4488226_ has no LightComponent, emissive_light_source=false, and both material slots assigned to M_NonEmissive_Black_OffScreen. Setup_PlayerStart is at (300, -1000, 120), yaw -74.114, facing the lamp. The 22-map package was recooked successfully and contains the edited map/off-screen material. The ledger launch override disables the camera flashlight by default, so the table lamp is the only intended runtime light source unless passthrough --enable-flashlight is used. Runtime visual validation remains pending.

Only runtime light intended to remain active is Infinigen189cc130_TableLamp_650lm_PointLight; this environment overrides realistic-2x with --disable-flashlight so the camera flashlight is not spawned.
The monitor/screen actor is explicitly non-emissive: no LightComponent, emissive_light_source=false, and both material slots use M_NonEmissive_Black_OffScreen.
The table-lamp PointLight was repositioned to (376.31, -1233.11, 119.769), on the lamp side farthest from the monitor, with distance_to_monitor_origin 51.18 cm.

The 2026-07-13 lamp-repositioned full-ledger recook packaged this edited table-lamp-only screen-off map; archived and staged paks both have sha256 4b9dc32d6c02ddad8093695f629f0428b0a1595822efbd8ecaac895ad94d53fa and size 5259388196 bytes.
To spawn the camera flashlight for this table-lamp scene, run spear live infinigen_189cc130 --setting realistic-2x -- --enable-flashlight; put --dry-run before -- when inspecting the command.
